summary: Designed and developed scalable features for QuoteShop, an Australian quotation management SaaS platform.
Developed REST API endpoints using Python and Flask, improving average response reliability and reducing client-reported integration errors.
Built modular, reusable frontend components in Angular and TypeScript, improving component isolation and reducing UI-related bug reports.
Contributed to PostgreSQL schema design and query optimisation, improving dashboard load times for data-heavy views.
Integrated third-party APIs (payment gateways and hardware store platforms) to automate transactions, improve supply chain connectivity, and enhance overall system efficiency
Conducted peer code reviews and enforced clean-code standards across the team, reducing post-merge defects in reviewed PRs.
Collaborated with the architecture team on system design decisions affecting platform scalability and maintainability.
Mentored an intern in backend development, focusing on API design, clean code architecture, and software design principles.
Contributed React.js frontend components across 3 assigned feature modules, meeting all sprint deadlines.
Collaborated in an Agile team environment, participating in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
